title: Look up member {{memberId}} and read their current savings balance

summary.does: Discovered from the goal "look up member {{memberId}} and read their current savings balance" on coreone (tenant-a): 7 steps, the first 4 signing on. It commits no irreversible change in the core system.
summary.needs: memberId (string, sensitive): The memberId input (declared with --input). The operator credential is resolved at run time from the credential store (mockbank-operator).
summary.returns: On success: savingsBalance (decimal, sensitive). Business outcomes: member_not_found, validation_rejected, permission_denied.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: The savingsBalance value read from the screen (declared with --output).

steps.description: Type the operator user id from the credential store (mockbank-operator) into textbox "User ID".

ladder.rationale: The control has no accessible name: its label "User ID" sits in the adjacent table cell (no <label for>, no id, no ARIA), so role and label rungs cannot find it. Breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: element 1 of its kind (input) in the container holding "Sign On". Breaks whenever an element of that kind is added or reordered before it.
